name: Matsuri
source:
"[i]U-Um, Onii-sama, uh... N-Never mind...[/i]"

A young lady who falls in love with the protagonist at first sight.
Though she admires him from the bottom of her heart, circumstances prevent her from being by his side.
Thus, she entrusts Kosaka Miyori to observe him and write detailed reports.
Reading these observation diaries is the highlight of her day.

Class: Academy for Young Ladies, Year 2
Height: 129cm
Birthday: April 19th
Likes: Onee-sama, topics about romance
Dislikes: Being treated too much like a lady
